scripts.build: rm -rf build-web dist && emcmake cmake -B build-web -DWERROR=ON -DPLATFORM=web -DBACKEND=web -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION=ON && cmake --build build-web -j && mkdir dist && cp build-web/butterscotch.mjs build-web/butterscotch.wasm dist/
scripts.test: node --test scripts/next-version.test.mjs scripts/publish-feed.test.mjs scripts/prune-old-versions.test.mjs && tsx --test host/src/paths.test.ts
scripts.package: rm -rf plugin && mkdir plugin && cp -R dist/. host/dist/. plugin/ && cp LICENSE NOTICE plugin/
